description: Exact third-party AI provider CLI versions this repository qualifies. A provider with a non-null supported_version must report exactly that version, or, when version_match is "minimum", that version or newer within the same major version; anything else is unqualified and fails closed before paid work. Secret-free by contract: never add credentials, hosts, or account identifiers here.

grok.model_pin_notes: Owner ruling 2026-09-25: Grok 4.6 only, never 4.7. xAI remote launch campaigns replace the default model and beat config.toml, so the installers set models.default and allowed_models = ["<pin>*"] in ~/.grok/config.toml and add dismiss_campaigns (plus any cached campaign naming another default) to ~/.grok/campaigns_state.json. ~/.grok/requirements.toml cannot be used: Grok's deployment sync deletes it on start. allowed_models with an undismissed campaign refuses every session, even --model <pin>.
grok.notes: Minimum supported version (floor). Grok auto-updates, so any build at or above the floor within the same major version is accepted (a new major release still needs qualification); owner ruling 2026-09-23 (issue #686) replaced the exact pin, which blocked every review whenever Grok updated itself. Qualified originally by issue #251; the wrappers still refuse a build below the floor or one that reports no version.
